page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number left and running title centre-right. Main text in one column, with an initial woodcut at the left of the paragraph beginning "Xcifo regno". Marginal notes in the left margin beside that paragraph (Iosephus, Antiquitates; Ierem.; Berosus apud Ioseph.).

main_text.l: Babylonem variis structuris exornavit. Adjecit tum
veteri urbi alteram, ac ne hostes, deinceps
eam obsessuri, averso flumine eam aggredi possent,

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are partly faded; the readings "Iosephus, Antiquitates" and the reference abbreviations are approximate. The initial woodcut is an ornamental block and is not transcribed. Some words in the text (e.g. "transtulit", "invasit", "aggredi") are damaged by the ink and uncertain; the words "obsidionem", "pervenit" and "invasit" may be read differently. A word at the right edge ("triplici") is cut off at the page edge.
